periods.summary: Naseem answers Or-Gaule's invitation in exchange for the right to take Vermillion and Quedland after their collapse. He saves Or-Gaule by ambushing Wallenshtein from inside the old swordsman's body and dehydrating him into a mummy. At Caldia he appears on the west avenue, defeats Dandallion and many soldiers, and fights Stella with only his left hand at first. His punches are impossibly heavy because his true nature is not simple sand manipulation but dehydration: he removes water and turns matter, bodies, and even ground into dead sand. Stella identifies part of the trick but is unable to stop his right-handed escalation. Nene Saikyo's meteor/gravity intervention prevents his strike from devastating the area; he reveals the scale of his Haboob-like ability, then prepares to fight Nene before Or-Gaule interrupts.

key_events.summary: Kills Wallenshtein by ambush to save Or-Gaule and joins the new faction.
Overwhelms Stella, reveals his dehydration power, and clashes with Nene's intervention.
His fight with Nene is suspended by Or-Gaule's announcement.

abilities: dehydration / drying of matter and bodies
